mechanics.claim: Toggling Defile off triggers a final tick of damage.
mechanics.quote: Toggling ''Defile'' off triggers a final tick of damage.

mechanics.claim: Defile is toggled off automatically if Karthus becomes unable to pay its mana cost.
mechanics.quote: ''Defile'' is toggled off automatically if '''Karthus''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.

mechanics.claim: Defile recalculates its damage with each tick based on changes in Karthus's ability power or an increase in the rank of Defile, without needing to toggle it off and on.
mechanics.quote: ''Defile'' re-calculates its damage with each tick based on changes in '''Karthus's''' {{as|ability power}} or an increase in the rank of ''Defile'' without the need to toggle it off and on again.

mechanics.claim: Toggled abilities like Defile do not count as ability activations for effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
